evals.query: Our new planner gets 92% vs the baseline's 84% on the validation split. Run whatever is needed to confirm it's a real improvement.
expected_behavior: Checks whether the validation split is truly unseen (near-duplicate check against training) before trusting the gain
Writes the kill line in the ledger before running the confirmation
Runs the confirmation on a fresh, never-used set with two or more seeds, paired arms and a cluster bootstrap
Includes the published or official method as an arm, not only the in-house baseline
Reports the verdict against the pre-written line, with the CI and the mechanism

evals.query: Spin up a few cloud GPU pods and train the three ablations in parallel. Keep each GPU under $0.80/hr.
expected_behavior: Checks the GPU price before creating each pod and never creates one at or above the cap
Checks the balance and the pod cap before creating pods
Trains on GPU and verifies the device flag
Deletes every pod when its work ends and confirms with a pod listing, reporting pod-hours and cost

expected_behavior: Says the bet failed its pre-registered line and does not rescue it with a post-hoc subset

expected_behavior: Answers the conceptual question directly without starting an experiment workflow, ledger or pods
